title: Auth — OOB Prove — payload
description: The lock holder proves membership and the number on the starter's screen by carrying a signed auth/oob/identify document, and gets back the service-signed step 2. Issued and signed by the lock key `K_a`. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, parentThreadId, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

identify.description: A complete, signed auth/oob/identify/0.1 Trust Task document, issued by the approving DID and signed by its VTA for `authentication`. The service verifies it as a document in its own right — envelope, proof and payload against that specification's schema — over the members exactly as received: its proof covers every member, so it is deliberately an open object here rather than a typed one a binding could narrow.

Response.title: Auth — OOB Prove — response payload (step 2)
Response.description: Step 2 of the disclosure ladder, signed by the service's assertionMethod key: the step 1 members unchanged, plus the starter's key, where the request came from, and which DID was identified. The SHA-256 of its JCS canonical form, proof included, is the grant's `contextDigest`.

decisionDeadline.description: Unchanged from step 1 (integer UTC epoch seconds).

sessionKey.description: The starter key `K_b`: the key a grant would let act as the identified DID.

identifiedAs.description: The DID that issued the verified identify document. A grant must come from this DID.
